4 of 7 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment

The committee discussed the Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment, a review of the company's compliance with tort laws. The committee reviewed the company's risk management practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To approve for talent attraction: RESOLVED, that the Employee Stock Plan Administration Committee approves the company's response to the shareholder proposal regarding Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment.

Moved: Mariam Woods  •  Seconded: Weiwei Bhatt
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Regional Business Review: APAC

The committee considered the Regional Business Review: APAC, a proposal to adopt a new policy on employee privacy. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for status: RESOLVED, that the Employee Stock Plan Administration Committee approves the selection of Giving Advisory Group as the vendor for the Regional Business Review: APAC and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Mariam Woods  •  Seconded: Aysegul Parsons
Vote: 3 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Conflict of Interest Disclosures

The committee considered the Conflict of Interest Disclosures, a proposal to adopt a new policy on related-party transactions. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for exit: RESOLVED, that the Employee Stock Plan Administration Committee approves the grant of 149 performance share units to the executive team, subject to the performance conditions outlined in Exhibit C.

Moved: Aysegul Parsons  •  Seconded: Weiwei Bhatt
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Independent Director Session: Board Effectiveness

The committee received an update on the Independent Director Session: Board Effectiveness from Laszlo Baker. The project is currently on schedule and under budget. The next major milestone is 2015-08-28. No committee action was required.
